company description: Recursion Partners backs exceptional teams building vertical AI-enabled services platforms—businesses that combine applied AI, deep customer ownership, and strategic M&A to deliver outcomes for clients.\r\rConverting AI software into high-impact business outcomes is hard, and many companies lack the capacity to operationalize this at scale. Increasingly, they are turning to tech-enabled partners that can own and orchestrate this complexity, embed deeply into workflows, and be accountable for delivering high-quality outcomes.\r\rThese businesses compound through a recursive loop. Each engagement deepens domain expertise, generates proprietary data, and embeds it into workflows—creating feedback loops that continuously improve AI capabilities and their application.\r\rThe best platforms achieve meaningful margin expansion as AI performs a greater share of the work, while also driving revenue growth through new margin-accretive AI-enabled offerings. As a result, they exhibit more durable and attractive economics than traditional services providers, with the potential to increasingly resemble software businesses.\r\rProgrammatic M&A further accelerates this compounding by aggregating capabilities, customer relationships, and datasets onto a common platform—expanding workflow footprint, deepening data advantage, and improving AI performance with each transaction.\r\rWe focus on fragmented markets across healthcare, financial services, and business services—areas with complex workflows, regulatory requirements, and structurally low technology adoption.\r\rWe invest across two archetypes: AI-enabled roll-ups and the AI-led evolution of incumbent mid-market tech-enabled services providers, pursuing both significant minority and control investments, with a primary focus on the US and a secondary focus on India and Australia.\r\rIf you're building, scaling, or investing in this space—we’d love to connect.

bio: I build consumer brands people trust with their health, their data, and their decisions — and back the brand work with the analytical rigor to prove it pays off.I'm the Chief Marketing Officer at MyFitnessPal, where I lead a two-brand portfolio (MyFitnessPal and Cal AI) across brand, growth, creative, PR, and B2B partnerships. headline: CEO, Chairman - Founder Echelon Fitness Multimedia
bio: Lou Lentine is the founder and CEO of Echelon Fitness, a leader in connected fitness technology that blends innovation, AI, and wellness to improve lives. Since 2017, Lou has built Echelon into a global platform that delivers intelligent, accessible, and engaging fitness experiences both at home and in commercial environments.\r\rToday, Echelon produces up to 2,000 live classes each month from nine studios in Chattanooga, Miami, and Dubai, supported by thousands of on-demand workouts. Members can train with expert instructors across cycling, rowing, boxing, yoga, and more—all powered by AI-driven personalization, adaptive resistance, and real-time performance tracking. The platform also includes AI virtual rides for bikes, treadmills, and rowers, as well as interactive gaming through the FITos platform, merging fitness and entertainment to keep members motivated.\r\rEchelon’s reach extends far beyond the home. In 2021, the company launched a complete commercial fitness line, including a full range of cardio equipment and the Strength IQ AI-powered strength training systems. These solutions are now deployed across major gym chains, hotels, and wellness facilities worldwide, bringing the same innovation and personalization to large-scale environments that members enjoy at home.\r\rLou’s vision for Echelon is to stand at the intersection of fitness, wellness, and longevity—using technology not just to power workouts, but to help people extend their vitality and improve overall health.\r\rBefore founding Echelon, Lou spent three decades as an inventor and entrepreneur, filing more than 100 patents and creating some of the most recognized consumer products in the world. Among them, the Star Shower holiday lighting system sold over 20 million units in just a few years, while the Hurricane Spin Mop, Renu-it Battery Regenerator, and Mighty Jump emergency car starter became international bestsellers at Walmart, Target, CVS, Walgreens, HSN, and QVC. His entrepreneurial journey has earned him numerous honors including the World Trade Book of Honor Award, Exporter of the Year, Deloitte & Touche Fast 50 & Fast 500, University of Central Florida Alumni of the Year, and a nomination for Ernst & Young’s Entrepreneur of the Year.\r\rLou Lentine continues to lead with the mindset of an inventor—turning ideas into platforms that combine design, AI, and wellness to help millions of people move better, live healthier, and pursue longer, more connected lives.

bio: I'm a consumer health & wellness enthusiast, CEO, entrepreneur, Advisor, and Board Director. I founded Supergut, the leading gut health nutrition brand offering clinically-validated supplements and functional foods that improve digestion, balance blood sugar, and curb cravings by naturally boosting GLP-1.\r\rI created Supergut (fka Muniq) in honor of my late sister, Monica, who suffered from diabetes and other chronic health issues. company description: The Northern California Employee Benefits Council (NCEBC) began in the 1980s as an informal gathering of friends in the benefits industry to discuss current events impacting the profession. The organization and its mission grew steadily over time.\r\rIn December, 1992, we became a non-profit entity with official bylaws.\r\rToday, the NCEBC focuses on fostering a better understanding of the issues facing the employee benefits field, helping build relationships among industry peers, and giving back to the community in which we work and live.\r\rNCEBC members include representatives of insurance companies, brokerage and consulting firms, general agents, third-party administrators, HMOs, PPOs, specialty health organizations, and other professionals involved in the employee benefits industry. Ten officers and directors govern the organization.\r\rEngaging the Industry and the Community\r\rEach year, the NCEBC presents a series of educational programs covering a wide range of timely topics for the benefits industry. These conferences, together with signature events like an annual golf tournament and holiday party, give members opportunities to interact and network with colleagues.\r\rPhilanthropy is an equally important part of our identity, and we are proud to donate thousands of dollars each year to local and national charities. Currently the San Francisco Food Bank is primary beneficiary of our financial and hands-on support.\r\rNCEBC is proud to be recognized as an important part of the Northern California employee benefits community.\r\rWe invite you to learn more about the benefits of joining NCEBC.
